content: this is a summary of a legal case that took place in the klaipėda district court the case involved the division of matrimonial property between the applicant and the defendant the court decided to divide the property in kind with the applicant receiving two cars and the defendant receiving a nonresidential premises and a car the court also addressed other issues such as child maintenance and compensation the court dissolved the marriage between the parties and ordered the applicant to pay compensation to the defendant the court also upheld some claims from both parties and ordered them to share the costs of the proceedings the court specified that the defendant should be awarded something but did not provide details additionally the court ordered the applicant to pay the defendant a compensation for their greater share of a property and for the costs of serving procedural documents

civil_codes_used: Art. 3.117 Shares in the matrimonial property
Art. 3.100 Grounds for the termination of matrimonial community property
